summary: Static keyword co-occurrence in bundled Solana web3.js library
details: Package is the Solana Labs JavaScript SDK for interacting with the Solana blockchain. Pattern matches fired on the bundled lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js due to keyword co-occurrence (require('child_process'), fetch/POST/GET, https.get, ping) inside the rolled-up library bundle. These primitives are consistent with a JSON-RPC client SDK: fetch/POST/GET are used to talk to user-configured RPC endpoints, https.get and ping appear in connection/health-check helpers, and child_process is referenced from optional Node helpers. No lifecycle install hooks, no hardcoded attacker-controlled exfiltration destination, and no credential/env scraping path were identified in the scanned content. Behavior in the bundle is reachable only when consuming code explicitly invokes the SDK's public API against a caller-supplied RPC URL. Routing to human review since deeper tracing did not complete on a large minified bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
